Stage: Inbound truck waiting (checked in - unloading not started)
Meaning: Trailer status Open for Receiving / Checked In (WMS trlr_stat OR, CI). Age = minutes since the last trailer status change.
Action: Assign a dock door and start unloading; check door availability and the receiving crew.

Stage: Inbound truck unloading / receiving
Meaning: Trailer status Receiving / Unloading / Suspended (R, UNLD, SUSP).
Action: Check RF receiving scans at the door; fix ASN / label problems that block the receipt.

Stage: Inbound truck received - not closed / dispatched
Meaning: Trailer status Closed / Pending Dispatch (C, P) - the truck is still on site in WMS.
Action: Close the receipt and dispatch the trailer in WMS (TCLOSE / TDSP); check open receipt discrepancies.

Stage: Pallet on the receiving dock - not put away
Meaning: Pallets in a receiving-dock location (location type receiving stage, or area AREA_RCV_DOCK) - received, not put away. Age = minutes since the pallet's last move.
Action: Release put-away work; add forklift drivers at the receiving dock; check put-away location errors.

Stage: Pallet at end of line - not taken away
Meaning: Finished pallets on an end-of-line location (LOC_EOL / LOC_EOL_EXACT).
Action: Send a take-away driver to the line; check LTA lane capacity.

Stage: Pallet in the LTA take-away lane
Meaning: Pallets in the line take-away lanes (LOC_LTA).
Action: Prioritise LTA take-away; check free storage (Level A / free spots) and the put-away work queue.

Stage: Pallet in a hand-off (HOFF) lane
Meaning: Pallets in the hand-off lanes (LOC_HOFF_IN / LOC_HOFF_OUT).
Action: Move HOFF pallets on to storage or the dock; check hand-off confirmations.

Stage: Pallet on a forklift / RF device (moving)
Meaning: Pallets held on an RF device / forklift location (area AREA_RDTS) - picked up but not deposited.
Action: Complete the deposit on the RF; check abandoned RF sessions and the device location.

Stage: Pallet in a problem / hold location
Meaning: Pallets in problem / hold locations (LOC_PROBLEM).
Action: Investigate and clear the problem location (QA hold / damage / wrong label).

Stage: Pallet in the returns area
Meaning: Pallets in return locations (LOC_RETURN).
Action: Process returns: inspect, re-label, put away or scrap.

Stage: Shipment ready - picking not started
Meaning: Shipment status Ready (shpsts R) - created but no pick released yet. Age = minutes since the shipment was created.
Action: Release / plan the wave; check allocation (stock shortage) and pick-work generation.

Stage: Shipment being picked (in process)
Meaning: Shipment status In-Process (I) - allocated / picking. Age = minutes since allocation (or creation).
Action: Check pick-work progress and shortages; replenish the pick faces.

Stage: Shipment staged - waiting for loading
Meaning: Shipment status Staged (S). Age = minutes since staging.
Action: Call the truck / assign a door; load staged shipments first (FIFO).

Stage: Shipment loading / loaded - not completed
Meaning: Shipment status Loading / Loaded (L, D). Age = minutes since loading started (or staging).
Action: Finish loading and confirm Load Complete; check missing pallets of the shipment.

Stage: Pallet at the ship dock / staging lane
Meaning: Pallets in shipping-stage / dock-door locations (location type ship dock or stage / LOC_DOOR_PATTERN).
Action: Load the staged pallets; check the trailer at the door and the loading crew.

Stage: Outbound truck waiting (open - loading not started)
Meaning: Trailer status Open for Shipping / Open for Loading / Checked In (O, OLDG, CI).
Action: Assign the door and start loading; check the staged pallets for the load.

Stage: Outbound truck loading
Meaning: Trailer status Loading / Suspended (LDG, SUSP).
Action: Add loaders / forklifts; check missing pallets (picking or replenishment delay).

Stage: Outbound truck loaded - not closed / dispatched
Meaning: Trailer status Loaded / Closed / Pending Dispatch (L, C, P).
Action: Close and dispatch the trailer in WMS (documents, seal).

Stage: Pallet on a trailer not yet dispatched
Meaning: Pallets whose location is a trailer that is still on site (trailer status in config/trailer_status.csv) - loaded but not dispatched. Pallets on dispatched trailers stay in PrIME stock on the trailer location and are excluded (X_TRAILER_OFFSITE).
Action: Dispatch the trailer in WMS once loaded - pallets stay in stock on the trailer until TDSP.

Stage: Pallet on a dispatched / unknown trailer (excluded)
Meaning: Shipped pallets: PrIME keeps them on the trailer location after dispatch (TDSP). Flow_No 0 = filtered out of the feed.
